nodeTemplates.title: Subscription templates
nodeTemplates.description: Manage client documents, format defaults and ordered User-Agent rules. Templates contain no generated member credentials.
nodeTemplates.rulesHint: The first match selects its template or browser page. Explicit format takes precedence; unmatched requests use client detection and Base64. Patterns use Go regex syntax.
nodeTemplates.empty: No custom templates. Built-in rendering remains available.
nodeTemplates.markerHint: Use { SubscriptionProxies: {} } once inside outbounds, or proxies for Clash Meta. Use { SubscriptionNames: {} } inside selector lists. Markers must be separate array entries. Templates are JSON; Clash previews are YAML.
nodeTemplates.clientAssets: Local certificate or geodata files must be available on the client.
nodeTemplates.removeHint: Templates referenced by defaults, retained assignments or regex rules cannot be deleted.
nodeTemplates.saveFailed: Could not save. Check user IDs, template references and validation, or reload after a revision conflict.
